purpose: The only place an assimilation bucket may be granted. scripts/assimilate/inventory.py reads this file and nothing else when it decides whether an indexed asset is classified, so `pnpm run assimilate` (the A1 coverage gate) can only go green when a human has written a decision here. Filenames, extensions and project hints never classify anything.
keyedOn: sha256 of the file as stored. relativePath is accepted as a fallback key for assets whose bytes are still Git LFS pointer stubs, because after `git lfs pull` the hash changes and every hash key must be re-checked.

buckets.used:numbers: the asset feeds a variable, coefficient or constraint in the engine or workbook
buckets.used:narrative: the asset contributed a report template or clause wording
buckets.used:drawing: the asset is mapped into the layout/drawing manifest
buckets.superseded: a duplicate of a higher-precedence source; the superseded hash stays here
buckets.out-of-scope: deliberately excluded — the reason is the deliverable, not an omission

rules: Every decision needs `reason` and `decidedBy`. A bucket without both is treated as unclassified.
`unclassified` is not a valid value here; leaving a file out of this list is how it stays unclassified.
Do not classify a Git LFS pointer stub. Materialise it (`git lfs pull --include="<path>"`), re-run `pnpm run assets:inventory`, then classify the real bytes.
Decisions are engineering/review claims about provenance. They belong to the same licensed-engineer review that `engineering/review/` is still waiting for.

example.reason: Supplies the pier design moment envelope reproduced on sheet 12.
